translations: Hurry up, or you'll miss your plane.

usageExamples: Quando si viaggia in bus o in treno, si deve pagare il biglietto.
When riding a bus or a train, you need to pay the fare.
Non so se lui verrà in treno o in auto.
I don't know whether he'll come by train or by car.
Lui va a scuola a piedi o in bici?
Does he go to school on foot or by bicycle?
